text:
Aisha: Quick sync 1 we need to lock the webinar topic and rehearsal schedule by EOD. Preference: 45m talk + 10m live demo + 15m Q&A.
Jon: That split works. Keep demo focused on one cost/perf comparison and one fallback.
Priya: Proposed title: 'Practical LLM Serving: Benchmarks & Failovers' 1 clear and punchy?
Aisha: I like it. Priya, can you draft 3 short abstracts (eng, product, case study)? Marco will pick the case-study voice.
Marco: Yes. Also will draft the enterprise CTA for the registration form.
Emilia: Need speaker confirmation for demo infra. @Oliver, can you run hosted + fallback path in a dry-run? :eyes:
Oliver: Confirmed. Request a 30m tech check for SSH, model pull, and firewall the day before. Will prepare a docker fallback: `docker run redwood/demo-proxy:stable --mode=local`.
DeployBot: Reminder: reserve GPU queue for dress rehearsal on 2024-11-15 16:00 UTC.
Aisha: Thanks. Proposed rehearsal timeline:
- Day -2: 30m tech check (infra + slides + demo env)
- Day -1: 60m full dress rehearsal (end-to-end)
- Show day: 15m pre-warm + 5m AV check + session
Emilia: Dress rehearsal at 16:00 UTC works for NA/EU overlap. Also capture recording and timestamp demo segment for the on-demand clip.
Priya: I'll write hero copy + three learning bullets for promo. Also sample tweets.
Marco: Lead routing: self-serve signups -> marketing CRM; enterprise interest -> sales. I'll own playbook and tags: webinar:registrant, interest:dedicated, interest:private-deploy.
Jon: I'll moderate and triage audience questions, and sync with sales on enterprise routing.
Aisha: Final checklist: abstracts by tomorrow noon, speaker bios + headshots by EOD, demo checklist PR by Friday. Any blockers?
Priya: Abstract + slides outline by noon.
Oliver: Demo checklist PR by Friday morning; will test hosted + fallback flows during tech check and simulate model cold start.
Aisha: Adding a 5m buffer after the demo for a live poll. Updated show day flow: 45m talk, 10m demo, 5m poll, 15m Q&A.
Marco: I'll draft registration copy and send to design.
Aisha: Great 1 I'll compile run-of-show and share for comments. :rocket:
